narr: A line of thunderstorms moved northeastward through the Tucson Metro area causing damage to a roof, tree branches downed, and a palm tree uprooted. These thunderstorms were slow moving and allowed heavy rainfall of 0.5-1.15 inches of localized rainfall that lead to a swift water rescue and multiple road closures due to flash flooding.
ev: Heavy rainfall due to thunderstorm activity caused flash flooding on 1st street from River Rd to Grant Rd. Swift water was crossing roads at several junctions. A rainfall gauge in the area had 1.01 inches of rainfall in the span of 1 hour.
A thunderstorm produced heavy rainfall causing South Old Nogales Highway to close from Flato Wash to Lumber Road. A nearby rain gauge had 1.14 inches of rainfall in 1 hour.

Heavy rainfall due to a slow moving thunderstorm produced an estimated 0.5-1.0 inch of rainfall causing running washes and rivers. A swift water rescue took place at prince and river park drive with no injuries to the 4 people and dog saved from a car.
